name: OpenCreator Spoolman Integration
description: A Spoolman spool per tool through AFC, each tool books filament on its own spool.
note: After installing, put your Spoolman server's address in oc-spoolman.conf (next to moonraker.conf) and uncomment its [spoolman] section, then restart Moonraker and run FIRMWARE_RESTART. Optionally, group the SPOOLMAN_* macros in a Fluidd category by hand (README, Setup step 5).
author: JayKuswahey
